note: Corps of Engineers campground on the Mississippi (Pool 11) about two miles south of Potosi, with a boat ramp. Sites 28 and 30 back onto an open lawn that runs to the riprapped shore; the rest are shaded and set back. Self-service: a ranger or volunteer checks campers in at the site. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov facility record, rates, per-site catalog, calendar and site photos read; USACE MVR page refuses. $26 electric (2026 and 2027); 62 electric 50A sites (30-55 ft, all fit 23 ft) + 10 tent-only; reservation only; season May 1-Oct 24 from the calendar; no water hookups (filling tanks only). Riverview confirmed at least; sites 28 and 30 make a riverfront-with-caveat lead. Pin within ~100 m of the site centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade, reviewer's call): stored riverview. Sites 28 (42.64975,-90.69952) and 30 (42.64973,-90.69920), both nightly reservable electric sites, back onto an open campground lawn running to the Mississippi: on Esri imagery about 30-35 m to the top of the riprap and about 30 m (28) / 50 m (30) to open water, nothing between but grass, a few trees, benches and a swing set; the official recreation.gov photos of both pads show the open lawn and the river straight behind. The river is several hundred metres wide here (Pool 11). Under the 'a few clearly waterfront sites' rule this reads as riverfront with a caveat naming 28 and 30 (riprap shore; a swing set on the lawn). Site 49 (42.64921,-90.69751) is about 30 m from the water but through trees; 02 and 32 are 50 m+ through trees. Tent-only 64-69 sit closest to the backwater but are tent-only. riverview at minimum is confirmed.
SITES: stored 73 with note '63 electric, 8 tent-only (sites 64-73)' -> 72: 62 electric RV sites (02-63; 01 is a management site) and 10 tent-only (64-73) per the catalog.
HOOKUPS: electric 50 confirmed (catalog 50/30/20 on all 62); water false written from the notice 'Hooking up to water, except to fill your tank, is prohibited.'
SEASON: added 05-01..10-24 from the recreation.gov calendar (2026 nights end Oct 24, no April 2027 nights, May 2027 open from May 1); 2027 rate season ends Oct 23.
PIN: 42.6501,-90.6994 is about 100 m from the catalog's site centroid (42.64971,-90.69817), in the north loop. Fine. (rec.gov's own facility point 42.6594,-90.7097 is about 1.3 km off, in the river.)
PHONE: 563-582-0881 is recreation.gov's ranger office (also lists campground entrance station 608-763-2140). Keep.
WEBSITE: the MVR page answers 403 (Akamai) to plain HTTP; not retried; keep it. recreation.gov link live.
